'''Riebold's Foam and Sizzle''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reecee/Legends|Reecee]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] went there to question [[Dugo Bagy]] about [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] activities in the [[Dubrillion system/Legends|Dubrillion system]].
